components.title: Compute whole-trip average speed
components.what: Calculate driving times for 84 km at 60 km/h and 45 km at 45 km/h, convert the 25-minute stop to hours, add all elapsed time, divide total distance by total time, and round to one decimal place.

components.title: Present the answer
components.what: Show brief working, include the stop in total elapsed time, and end with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>, using digits only with a decimal point and no units on that line.

log.draft:
First segment time: 84 ÷ 60 = 1.4 hours.  
Stop time: 25 ÷ 60 = 0.4166667 hours.  
Second segment time: 45 ÷ 45 = 1 hour.

Total distance: 84 + 45 = 129 km.  
Total elapsed time: 1.4 + 0.4166667 + 1 = 2.8166667 hours.  
Average speed: 129 ÷ 2.8166667 = 45.798816... km/h, which rounds to 45.8 km/h.

FINAL: 45.8
